faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JRF position at IIITM Gwalior?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIITM Gwalior is 15th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed M.Tech/ M.S./M.E. or equivalent in EC/Electrical/CSE/IT, or B. Tech/ B.E./M.Sc. in EC/CSE/IT/EE or equivalent, and must have qualified GATE/NET.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their applications, followed by an offline interview.

faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the designated address.

faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow position will be as per DST norms.
